channel.title: Offshore North
channel.description:
Offshore ocean racing, explained weekly for English-speaking fans — with a Canadian angle. Every Monday: what Canada Ocean Racing did on the road to the Vendée Globe and what it actually means, the week in the IMOCA fleet and the wider offshore world, and one concept explained properly for people who love this sport without living inside it. Sources in every episode. No hype, no play-by-play.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

What This Show Is Offshore ocean racing is one of the great endurance sports on earth and is reported almost entirely in French.
